originalText:
第3章 
阿泽身形灵活地折下一根半干枯的树枝，三两下将其折成几段，搭了个简易的火架，陈启感觉自己有点像在吃白食的错觉，在树上待不住了，对树下忙碌的阿泽喊道：“阿泽，我可以下去吗？”
阿泽抬起头，“食物还没弄好。”
“只有你一个在忙怪不好意思的，我也可以帮忙。”
阿泽怔了怔，停下手上的动作，翻身几个起落出现在陈启面前，夕阳的余晖透过树缝洒在对方身上，或许是逆光的缘故，陈启发现对方的眼睛异常明亮，阿泽认真地看着陈启，笑了笑，轻声道：“好。”
阿泽蹲下身子，示意陈启趴到自己背上。陈启双手环过阿泽的脖子，阿泽的速度很快，但身形很平稳，陈启还没反应过来两人就落到了地上。陈启不由再次感叹一句兽人这强壮的体魄，“阿泽你真厉害。”
阿泽有点憨厚地绕绕头，在火堆旁边清理出一条隔离带，拿出火石将刚才架好的木柴点燃。然后在旁边挖了个不大的浅坑，只见阿泽拿起旁边的小疣猪，伸出右手，五指指甲瞬间变长，利落地处理疣猪。
陈启恍然地点点头，看着阿泽准备将串好的疣猪放到火堆上，又忍不住问：“不需要清洗一下吗？”
阿泽停下手中的动作，看见陈启脸色纠结地盯着自己手中的疣猪，想了想，将疣猪放下，搂起陈启回到树上，“你在这里等一下。”说完跳到树下，拿起放在兽皮上的疣猪消失在旁边的高草丛中。
等了许久，天色完全暗了下来，阿泽肩上扛着清洗干净的疣猪回来，头发带着水汽。看到陈启好端端地在树上，阿泽才暗暗松了口气。
translatedText:
Chapter 3

A Ze nimbly snapped off a half-withered branch, breaking it into several pieces in just a few motions to set up a simple fire rack. Feeling a bit like a freeloader, Chen Qi could no longer sit still up in the tree. He called down to the busy A Ze below, "A Ze, can I come down?"

A Ze looked up. "The food isn't ready yet."

"It feels embarrassing to let you do all the work alone. I can help too."

A Ze froze for a moment and stopped what he was doing. With a few agile leaps, he vaulted up the branches and appeared right in front of Chen Qi. The fading glow of the setting sun filtered through the gaps in the foliage and fell across him. Perhaps it was because he was backlit, but Chen Qi noticed that the other man's eyes looked exceptionally bright. A Ze gazed earnestly at Chen Qi, smiled, and said softly, "All right."

A Ze crouched down, gesturing for Chen Qi to climb onto his back. Chen Qi wrapped his arms around A Ze's neck. A Ze moved swiftly yet steadily; before Chen Qi could even register it, the two of them had already landed on the ground. Chen Qi could not help but marvel once more at the beastman's robust physique. "You're amazing, A Ze."

Looking a bit sheepish, A Ze scratched his head. He cleared a firebreak around the fire pit, took out a flint, and lit the firewood he had just arranged. Then, he dug a small, shallow pit nearby. He picked up the small warthog beside him, extended his right hand, and his fingernails instantly lengthened, allowing him to butcher the warthog with practiced efficiency.

Chen Qi nodded in realization. Seeing that A Ze was about to place the skewered warthog directly over the fire, he could not help but ask, "Doesn't it need to be washed?"

A Ze paused and saw Chen Qi staring at the warthog in his hands with a conflicted expression. After a moment of thought, he set the warthog down, gathered Chen Qi into his arms, and carried him back up into the tree. "Wait here a moment." With that, he leaped down, scooped up the warthog from the animal hide, and disappeared into the tall grass nearby.

After a long wait, the sky had darkened completely. A Ze returned with the washed-clean warthog slung over his shoulder, his hair damp with moisture. Only upon seeing that Chen Qi was safe and sound up in the tree did A Ze secretly breathe a sigh of relief.
